compatibility_policy.additive: New optional fields may be added without changing existing required fields.
compatibility_policy.breaking: Removing or renaming stable fields requires a new schema file or a clearly marked breaking entry.
compatibility_policy.documentation: Docs-only changes do not change the JSON output contract.
